commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin main
git reset --hard origin/main
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
cd projects/kobra2-neo
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

p = Path('src/kobra_plot.py')
s = p.read_text()
old = '''def merge_touching_polylines(polylines: list[Polyline], tolerance_mm: float = 0.02) -> list[Polyline]:
    if tolerance_mm < 0:
        raise GeometryError("merge tolerance must be non-negative")
    merged: list[Polyline] = []
    for line in polylines:
        if len(line) < 2:
            continue
        current = list(line)
        if merged and _distance(merged[-1][-1], current[0]) <= tolerance_mm:
            if _distance(merged[-1][-1], current[0]) > 1e-9:
                merged[-1].append(current[0])
            merged[-1].extend(current[1:])
        else:
            merged.append(current)
    return merged
'''
new = '''def merge_touching_polylines(polylines: list[Polyline], tolerance_mm: float = 0.02) -> list[Polyline]:
    if tolerance_mm < 0:
        raise GeometryError("merge tolerance must be non-negative")
    merged: list[Polyline] = []
    for line in polylines:
        if len(line) < 2:
            continue
        current = list(line)
        if not merged:
            merged.append(current)
            continue
        tail = merged[-1][-1]
        start_distance = _distance(tail, current[0])
        end_distance = _distance(tail, current[-1])
        if start_distance <= tolerance_mm:
            if start_distance > 1e-9:
                merged[-1].append(current[0])
            merged[-1].extend(current[1:])
        elif end_distance <= tolerance_mm:
            current.reverse()
            if end_distance > 1e-9:
                merged[-1].append(current[0])
            merged[-1].extend(current[1:])
        else:
            merged.append(current)
    return merged
'''
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('merge function block not found')
s = s.replace(old, new)
s = s.replace(
    '''    fitted = fit_to_profile(normalized_geometry, profile)
    fitted = merge_touching_polylines(fitted)
    output_bounds = bounds(fitted)
''',
    '''    fitted = fit_to_profile(normalized_geometry, profile)
    polylines_before_merge = len(fitted)
    fitted = merge_touching_polylines(fitted)
    output_bounds = bounds(fitted)
''',
)
s = s.replace(
    '''    stats = geometry_stats(fitted, profile)
    stats["input_bounds"] = input_bounds.as_dict()
    stats["output_bounds"] = output_bounds.as_dict()
''',
    '''    stats = geometry_stats(fitted, profile)
    stats["input_bounds"] = input_bounds.as_dict()
    stats["output_bounds"] = output_bounds.as_dict()
    stats["polylines_before_continuous_join"] = polylines_before_merge
    stats["continuous_joins"] = polylines_before_merge - len(fitted)
    stats["continuous_join_tolerance_mm"] = 0.02
''',
)
p.write_text(s)

p = Path('tests/test_kobra_plot.py')
s = p.read_text()
marker = '''def test_generated_gcode_is_safe() -> None:
'''
case = '''def test_merge_touching_polylines_reverses_touching_next_path() -> None:
    lines = [[(10.0, 50.0), (20.0, 60.0)], [(30.0, 70.0), (20.0, 60.0)]]
    merged = kp.merge_touching_polylines(lines, tolerance_mm=0.02)
    assert len(merged) == 1
    assert merged[0][-1] == (30.0, 70.0)


def test_merge_touching_polylines_does_not_bridge_gap() -> None:
    lines = [[(10.0, 50.0), (20.0, 60.0)], [(20.03, 60.0), (30.0, 70.0)]]
    merged = kp.merge_touching_polylines(lines, tolerance_mm=0.02)
    assert len(merged) == 2


'''
if 'test_merge_touching_polylines_reverses_touching_next_path' not in s:
    if marker not in s:
        raise SystemExit('test insertion marker not found')
    s = s.replace(marker, case + marker)
p.write_text(s)
PY
uv sync --frozen >/dev/null
uv run pytest -q
uv run python -m compileall -q src tests
git diff --check
git add src/kobra_plot.py tests/test_kobra_plot.py
git commit -m 'Handle reversed touching plot paths'
cd ../..
git push origin HEAD:main
echo RESULT:CONTINUOUS_PATH_CLOSEOUT_OK
